name: Pokemon Publisher v2
description: Publishes pending Pokemon TCG promotions to Telegram channel every 5min within posting window (8h-22h BRT), up to 30 posts/day.

parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS post_count FROM promos WHERE posted_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'posted';

SELECT p.*, c.codigo AS cupom_codigo, c.descricao AS cupom_descricao, c.valor_minimo_cents AS cupom_valor_minimo_cents, to_char(c.valido_ate AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS cupom_valido_ate_br FROM promos p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT cu.* FROM cupons cu WHERE cu.ativo = TRUE AND (cu.valido_de IS NULL OR cu.valido_de <= now()) AND (cu.valido_ate IS NULL OR cu.valido_ate >= now()) AND (cu.categoria_id IS NULL OR cu.categoria_id = p.category_id) ORDER BY cu.prioridade DESC, cu.valido_ate ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) c ON TRUE WHERE p.status = 'pending' AND p.utm_link IS NOT NULL AND p.utm_link LIKE '%matt_word=caed1312314%' AND p.utm_link LIKE '%matt_tool=96097202%' AND p.thumbnail IS NOT NULL AND p.thumbnail LIKE 'http%' ORDER BY p.discount_pct DESC LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO promos_erros (item_id, error_step, error_msg, payload) SELECT p.item_id, CASE WHEN (p.utm_link IS NULL OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_word=caed1312314%' OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_tool=96097202%') THEN 'afiliado' ELSE 'foto' END, CASE WHEN (p.utm_link IS NULL OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_word=caed1312314%' OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_tool=96097202%') THEN 'item pendente sem link de afiliado valido: nao sera publicado enquanto o utm_link nao for regravado' ELSE 'item pendente sem foto valida: nao sera publicado enquanto o thumbnail nao for corrigido' END, jsonb_build_object('utm_link', coalesce(p.utm_link, ''), 'permalink', coalesce(p.permalink, ''), 'thumbnail', coalesce(p.thumbnail, '')) FROM promos p WHERE p.status = 'pending' AND (p.utm_link IS NULL OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_word=caed1312314%' OR p.utm_link NOT LIKE '%matt_tool=96097202%' OR p.thumbnail IS NULL OR p.thumbnail NOT LIKE 'http%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM promos_erros e WHERE e.item_id = p.item_id AND e.error_step IN ('afiliado', 'foto'));
